Package com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat

Class DamageOverTime

java.lang.Object
com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat.StatusEffect
com.epitech.depthdiablo.combat.DamageOverTime
Direct Known Subclasses:
Burn, Poison
public abstract class DamageOverTime extends StatusEffect
Damage over time (GDD 1.3.1, 1.6): deals its damage at the end of every interval until its duration is over. The damage ignores invincibility, grants none, and is credited to the source.

Pattern: Template Method. The ticking is written once here; each kind (Burn, Poison) only gives its values, and the view tells them apart by their class.
